ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast macro distribution approximately 70% low-intensity (dark) to 30% high-intensity (white). High-intensity pixels are concentrated at distal tips and in punctate spots across the surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous high-intensity white regions at distal tips. Discrete circular blobs (5-20 pixel diameters) scattered across both lobes. A series of parallel linear high-intensity markings localized on the inner right lobe near the median notch.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with an internal angle of approximately 35-40 degrees; depth occupies roughly 1/5th of the visible vertical lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency irregular serrations. Left lobe trailing edge exhibits three distinct high-amplitude peaks (jagged protrusions). Right lobe shows more uniform, low-amplitude serrated topography.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave trailing edge curve originating from the median notch, sweeping upward and outward to sharp, high-intensity distal points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely packed high-contrast, textured clusters of white pixels at the extreme left and right distal tips. Isolated circular high-contrast spots scattered across the dark central pigmented areas.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A series of at least six parallel, vertically-oriented linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) appearing as high-intensity streaks against the low-intensity medial surface of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive textured calcified-appearing clusters at distal tips. Five to six parallel linear rake marks on the right lobe. Irregular deep notch on the trailing edge of the left lobe roughly midway between notch and tip.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly irregular and jagged silhouette of the far left distal tip compared to the relatively smoother (though serrated) right tip.
